decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, S01, EX11, EX12, EX13, EX14, PL31, PL32, PL33, PL34, and PL37 received: 15/01/2018. Heritage Statement dated 7th February 2018 received: 07/02/2018. Flood Risk Assessment dated 12/03/2018, Flood Risk Matrix, EX15 RevB, EX16, EX35 RevB and EX36 received: 12/03/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
description: Erection of a rear ground floor extension, a rear roof extension, a rear roof terrace, alterations to first floor rear window, replacement of boundary fence and minor internal alterations.
